english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken adjective when something may happen but is not certain.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that may become or happen but is not actual yet.
Use 有可能 when plausible means possible or likely, especially about an event or proposition rather than an acceptable explanation.

examples.english: It is possible that this will happen.
examples.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 ho2 nang4 faat3 sang1

examples.english: There is potential for this plan to start next year.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃有可能下年先開始。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 nang4 haa6 nin4 sin1 hoi1 ci2

examples.english: It is plausible that it will rain heavily tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ting1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 dou1 jau5 ho2 nang4
